relevance_rank_note: Measures surface LDLR directly after exogenous lipidated ApoE isoforms in human H4 neuroglioma cells, HAP1 cells and APOE KO iPSC-astrocytes, but the isoform effect is ApoE2 vs ApoE3/E4; ApoE3 and ApoE4 are reported together and behave alike, so for the H2 contrast (E4 vs E3) the paper is largely a null, with no ARF6 readout.

description: Cell-surface LDLR immunostaining (live, 4 C) in APOE KO human iPSC-derived astrocytes after 1 d of lipidated ApoE was lower with lipApoE3 and lipApoE4 than with lipApoE2, but lipApoE4 and lipApoE3 gave the same surface LDLR (bars ~0.95 each), i.e. no ApoE4-specific surface-receptor deficit. Brackets compare ApoE2 with ApoE3 and ApoE4 (and no ApoE with ApoE2); none joins ApoE3 and ApoE4 (one-way ANOVA with Sidak's selected comparisons), so APOE4 vs APOE3 may not have been tested and no P is given.
quote: In H4, WT HAP1, and APOE KO iAstrocytes, incubation with lipApoE3/E4 significantly reduced surface LDLR relative to lipApoE2, revealing impaired LDLR recycling
summary: (lipApoE3 -> lipApoE4) -> (no reported difference in surface LDLR; both lower than lipApoE2)
system: APOE KO human iPSC-derived astrocytes (iAstrocytes; isogenic KO from ThermoFisher A18945 iPSC line); Exogenous HEK293-purified recombinant human ApoE2/E3/E4, POPC/cholesterol-lipidated (lipApoE), 10 ug/mL for 1 d; live-cell surface LDLR immunostaining (R&D AF2148) and confocal quantification. Exogenous recombinant lipidated ApoE on an APOE-null background; receptor is LDLR.
human_check: Fig 2 image viewed (PMC CDN nihms-2034721-f0003.jpg). Main Fig 2 legend gives the test (one-way ANOVA, Sidak's selected comparisons) but no n and no star key; n read as plotted dots. No E3-vs-E4 bracket is drawn (brackets: noApoE vs E2 ****, E2 vs E3 ****, E2 vs E4 ****); with Sidak's selected comparisons E3 vs E4 may not have been tested, so this is 'no difference shown', not a tested null. The authors read E3/E4 vs E2 as impaired recycling. Class 1 -> 3 (team leader, 2026-11-21): steady-state surface level is B' in the directness guide; synthesis or breakdown could also change it, so it does not measure recycling itself.

description: APOE KO human iPSC-derived astrocytes internalized more lipidated ApoE4 than ApoE3 after 1 d (bars ~2.2 vs ~1.25, a single-star bracket joins E3 and E4), and the internalized ApoE sat with LDLR inside LAMP1 compartments, consistent with more LDLR held in endolysosomes with ApoE4. A single-star bracket joins ApoE3 and ApoE4, but the figure legend gives no star key, so no P threshold can be assigned.

summary: (lipApoE3 -> lipApoE4) -> (more lipApoE internalized, all colocalized with LDLR, mostly in LAMP1 compartments) -> (more LDLR diverted to endolysosomes, inferred)

description: Total (surface + intracellular) LDLR immunostaining in H4 cells after 1 d lipidated ApoE was modestly but significantly reduced and more clustered with lipApoE3/E4 (vs lipApoE2/control), with ApoE3 and ApoE4 reported together; ApoE4-treated cells showed ApoE-LDLR puncta outside transferrin-labelled recycling endosomes (ApoE4 only shown, no E3 comparator for that image). Brackets compare ApoE2 with ApoE3 and ApoE4 (and no ApoE with ApoE2); none joins ApoE3 and ApoE4 (one-way ANOVA with Sidak's selected comparisons), so APOE4 vs APOE3 may not have been tested and no P is given.
quote: Immunostaining of total LDLR (cell surface + intracellular) in H4 cells after lipApoE3/E4 treatment showed a modest but significant reduction in signals, which also appeared slightly more clustered (Figure 2E–F). Cell-associated ApoE immunoreactivity extensively colocalized with LDLR puncta (Figure 2G) outside of transferrin-labeled recycling endosomes (Figure S2D), suggesting “trapping” of LDLR by ApoE in other endolysosomal compartments.
summary: (lipApoE3 -> lipApoE4) -> (no reported difference in total LDLR or LDLR clustering; both trap LDLR outside recycling endosomes)
system: Human H4 neuroglioma cell line; Exogenous HEK293-purified recombinant human ApoE2/E3/E4, POPC/cholesterol-lipidated (lipApoE), 10 ug/mL for 1 d; total LDLR immunostaining with spot-density quantification; ApoE/LDLR co-immunostaining with 15 min Alexa488-transferrin pulse to mark recycling endosomes (Figure S2D, ApoE4 only). Tumour cell line in vitro.
human_check: Fig 2 image viewed (PMC CDN nihms-2034721-f0003.jpg). Main Fig 2 legend gives the test (one-way ANOVA, Sidak's selected comparisons) but no n and no star key; n read as plotted dots. Total LDLR (left graph of 2F) E3 and E4 bars both ~0.92; spot density (right graph) both ~1.05; brackets only compare E2 with E3/E4 (and noApoE with E2), none join E3 and E4. The 'outside transferrin-labeled recycling endosomes' part (Fig 2G, Figure S2D) is ApoE4-only, so it is not an E4 vs E3 contrast.

description: Super-resolution imaging in APOE KO iPSC-astrocytes showed internalised lipApoE fully colocalised with endogenous LDLR, largely in LAMP1 compartments; internalised ApoE and the fraction of LAMP1 vesicles containing ApoE (and hence LDLR) followed ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 (Mander's 0.497 +/- 0.090 E4 vs 0.410 +/- 0.049 E3 vs 0.266 +/- 0.045 E2), a trend toward more endolysosomal LDLR-ApoE cargo with ApoE4 than ApoE3; significance of E4 vs E3 not stated.
quote: ApoE isoform differences were manifested in the differential levels of internalized lipApoE (ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2), giving rise to the same isoform trend for LAMP1-positive vesicles containing ApoE immunoreactivity (Mander’s coefficients = 0.266 ± 0.045 for ApoE2, 0.410 ± 0.049 for ApoE3, 0.497 ± 0.090 for ApoE4) (Figure 2I).
system: APOE KO human iPSC-derived astrocytes; Exogenous HEK293-purified recombinant human ApoE2/E3/E4, POPC/cholesterol-lipidated (lipApoE), 10 ug/mL for 1 d; super-resolution confocal co-immunostaining of LAMP1, ApoE and LDLR, Mander's coefficients.
human_check: Fig 2 image viewed (PMC CDN nihms-2034721-f0003.jpg). Main Fig 2 legend gives the test (one-way ANOVA, Sidak's selected comparisons) but no n and no star key; n read as plotted dots. Right graph of 2I (LAMP1+ vesicles containing ApoE) has no significance brackets at all; Mander's means are printed in text. E4 > E3 is a non-tested trend. Recoded against (team leader, 2026-11-21, after blind review): E4 > E3 is an untested, non-significant trend, and the coding rule treats a non-significant trend as against.

description: DiI-LDL uptake (functional readout of surface LDLR) in H4 cells: co-treatment with lipApoE3 or lipApoE4 inhibited uptake by 60-65% (lipApoE2 no effect), and 1 d pre-treatment with lipApoE3/E4 nearly abolished uptake; ApoE3 and ApoE4 behaved alike, so no ApoE4-specific loss of LDLR function. No bracket joins ApoE3 and ApoE4 in either condition (two-way ANOVA with Tukey), and no P is given.
quote: both lipApoE3 and lipApoE4 led to 60–65% inhibition of DiI-LDL uptake, likely via a direct competition with LDL for LDLR binding, whereas lipApoE2 had no effect (Figure 2J, L). When DiI-LDL was spiked into media after 1d pre-treatment with lipApoE3/E4, DiI-LDL uptake was nearly abolished (Figure 2K, L).
summary: (lipApoE3 -> lipApoE4) -> (no reported difference in LDLR-mediated LDL uptake; both suppress it)
system: Serum-starved human H4 neuroglioma cells; exogenous recombinant lipidated ApoE2/E3/E4 10 ug/mL, co-treated with 10 ug/mL DiI-LDL for 3-4 h, or 1 d ApoE pre-treatment then 3-4 h DiI-LDL; confocal quantification. Tumour cell line in vitro.
